title: Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad
claims: The Durango & Silverton Narrow Gauge Railroad has operated continuously between Durango and Silverton since 1882.
Round-trip Silverton excursions depart from the Durango Depot and begin on 2 May.
The railroad is a National Historic Landmark.
The line was built to haul silver and gold ore, and passengers came for the scenery.
